title: Current firmware + valid project (the happy path)

setup.describe: Start from s2's state (fresh firmware), then push a project from Studio during the manual steps — the CLI upload path holds the port and must not race the browser.

manual: Name the board, then push an example project onto it from the gallery.
Wait until the card shows the running project.

emulated.note: `needs: s2` is satisfied by starting from the same board spelling on a fresh state dir — s2's end state IS a board running current firmware with no lpfs. The project is Fyeah Sign because that is what the silicon capture pushed, so the two traces are comparable at the point the push happens.

steps.name: Fyeah Sign
steps.describe: Pick an example project from the gallery.
Wait until the card shows the running project — the BOARD's own line, not the project's name, which the chooser's own button already puts on the page the moment it is picked.
LAST: the walk is already observed; this is the trace's own claim.
